integrity: Closed-form derivation and reproducible standard-library numerical phase-chain cross-check supplied. Numerical sampling is not a proof of global optimization; the proof is analytic. Independent scientific audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Stationary single-animal Erlang-1, Erlang-2, or Erlang-3 calls; perfect detection in two equal positive recording windows, no fixed deployment horizon. No result for higher stages, multiple species, heterogeneous inter-call rates, nonstationarity, imperfect detection or a constrained final time. Historical priority provisional.
title: Three renewal stages are the sharp onset of a finite optimal gap between two confirmatory acoustic windows
